name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 9 – Am 21
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 9a. Calls on the Member States to support the sending of UN peacekeepers to protect the 15 nuclear reactors in Ukraine, in close cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency mission; stresses that in accordance with its resolution 377, the UN General Assembly has subsidiary decision-making powers when the Security Council is not in a position to take adequate decisions on peacekeeping matters;
